subject: Money
title: Wealth Tax
description: A 1-minute de-risking session on Wealth Tax.

hook.text: Elon Musk's net worth rose $120 billion in one year. His income tax was close to zero. He didn't sell.

buildup.text: Income tax only triggers when you sell. Billionaires borrow against assets instead, paying no tax.

discovery.text: A wealth tax would tax the total value of assets annually, not just income. Norway and Spain have one.

twist.text: France tried a wealth tax and repealed it. Rich people moved to Belgium. Capital is mobile.

climax.text: Taxing wealth sounds fair but is hard to execute. Valuing art, businesses, and estates is subjective.

punchline.text: Easy to propose. Hard to collect.

quiz.question: Why do some billionaires pay very little income tax?
options: They borrow against assets instead of selling
